desc.zh: 行者不问虚名，唯以手中长刃引路。凡随他进军者，不论是人是妖，刀锋皆不迟疑。
desc.en: The Wanderer cares nothing for empty titles; he lets the odachi in his hands lead the way. Of those who march behind him, man or yokai, not one blade hesitates.
